# Opus Art Supplies

> > Opus Art Supplies is a professional art materials retailer offering curated collections from premium brands, beginner-friendly starter kits, and eco-conscious supplies alongside community events and membership benefits.

Opus Art Supplies serves artists of all skill levels with a comprehensive catalog spanning paints, brushes, drawing sets, and specialty materials from industry-leading brands like Liquitex, Winsor & Newton, Caran d'Ache, and Faber-Castell. The retailer emphasizes community engagement through member events, workshops, and seasonal activities while maintaining both online and physical retail locations across Canada and North America.

## Premium Collections & Curated Brands

- [The Collection](https://opusartsupplies.com/pages/the-collection): Curated collection of premium art brands including Lascaux, Schmincke, and specialty paints.
- [Opus Studio Essentials](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/opus-studio-essentials): Professional-grade, affordable Opus-branded canvas, sketchbooks, and painting materials.
- [Eco-Conscious Art Materials](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/eco-conscious-art-materials): Sustainable and environmentally-friendly art supplies from eco-conscious brands.

## Paint & Drawing Sets

- [Paint Sets](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/paint-set): Premium watercolor, acrylic, oil, and gouache paint sets for beginners to professionals.
- [Drawing Sets](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/shop-drawing-sets): Premium drawing sets from Caran d'Ache, Faber-Castell, and Holbein with colored pencils.
- [Acrylic Paints](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/acrylic-paints): Acrylic paint tubes and sets from GOLDEN, Liquitex, and other professional brands.
- [Brush Sets](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/brush-sets): Artist brush collections including watercolor and travel sets from Princeton and others.
- [Marker Sets](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/marker-sets): Marker and pen sets from Pentel, Faber-Castell, and Winsor & Newton for artists.

## Starter Kits & Family-Friendly Supplies

- [Starter Sets](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/beginner-sets): Beginner-friendly art starter kits with acrylic, watercolor, oil, and drawing supplies.
- [Art Supplies For Kids](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/art-supplies-for-kids): Family-friendly art supplies including crayons, paints, clay, and beginner materials.
- [Must Try Summer Activities](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/must-try-summer-activities): Seasonal craft kits featuring tie-dye, cyanotype, printing, and fabric painting projects.

## Member Benefits & Community

- [Member Offers](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/sales-specials): Member-exclusive sales and promotions featuring rotating deals on art supplies and special collections.
- [Member Events](https://opusartsupplies.com/collections/events-demos): Community workshops, demonstrations, and art classes at Opus retail locations.
- [Gift Cards](https://opusartsupplies.com/products/opus-art-supplies-gift-cards): Gift cards for Opus Art Supplies with membership benefits and promotional offers.
